name: comparison-slider
title: Comparison Slider
description: A before/after reveal split by a draggable divider that is also a keyboard slider (arrows, page keys, home and end).

props.name: before
props.description: Layer shown left of the divider.

props.name: after
props.description: Layer shown right of the divider.

props.name: beforeLabel
props.description: Corner tag for the left layer.

props.name: afterLabel
props.description: Corner tag for the right layer.

props.name: position
props.description: Controlled divider position, 0 to 100. Pair with onPositionChange.

props.name: onPositionChange
props.description: Called when the pointer or keys move the divider.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root; give it an aspect ratio or height.
